notes.text: During small-group number activities, matches numerals 1 to 3 to groups of counters with teacher prompting.
In the same small-group number activities, matches numerals 1 to 6 to counters with teacher prompting. Enjoyment was not recorded.
During a small-group shop activity, selects a numeral card from 1 to 6 and counts out the matching number of toy fruits. Needs a teacher reminder to touch each fruit once.

expected.forbidden: No matching numerals to 8, independent comparison, enthusiasm inferred from participation, invented explanation or goals.

notes.text: During shared block play with two classmates, needs the teacher to model the words for asking to use a block.
During shared block play with two classmates, asks for a turn using the teacher's suggested phrase after a verbal reminder.

During one shared block activity with two classmates, asks to use a block without a teacher prompt. Teacher notes describe energetic participation: carries blocks to the building area and contributes ideas for a bridge.

In the last three shared block activities with two classmates, contributes ideas to the shared construction and asks for a turn after a teacher reminder. Still needs reminders to wait until a peer has finished speaking. No unprompted request was recorded in those three sessions.

expected.must_preserve: Modelled words to prompted turn request; May one unprompted request and observed energy; last three June sessions need turn-request and listening reminders; two classmates.
expected.forbidden: No current universal independence, loss of reminders, negative label, permanent regression, fabricated cause, resolving disagreements or home advice.
